jaguar.definition: A large spotted feline of tropical America similar to the leopard.

toucan.definition: Brilliantly colored arboreal fruit-eating bird of tropical America having a very large thin-walled beak.
toucan.exampleUsage: The toucan was identified during the lesson.

parrot.definition: Usually brightly colored zygodactyl tropical birds with short hooked beaks and the ability to mimic sounds.
parrot.exampleUsage: The parrot was identified during the lesson.

monkey.definition: To do random, unplanned work or activities or spend time idly.

gorilla.definition: A very large African ape with dark fur and great strength.

sloth.definition: A disinclination to work or exert yourself.

tree-frog.arabicTranslation: كائن أو عنصر طبيعي يُسمّى «تريي فروج»
tree-frog.definition: A small frog adapted to climb and live in trees.

anaconda.definition: Large arboreal boa of tropical South America.

chameleon.definition: A faint constellation in the polar region of the Southern Hemisphere near Apus and Mensa.

tapir.definition: Large inoffensive chiefly nocturnal ungulate of tropical America and southeast Asia having a heavy body and fleshy snout.

iguana.definition: Large herbivorous tropical American arboreal lizards with a spiny crest along the back.

orangutan.definition: Large long-armed ape of Borneo and Sumatra having arboreal habits.

butterfly.definition: A flying insect with colourful wings.
butterfly.exampleUsage: The butterfly was identified during the lesson.

beetle.definition: An insect whose front wings form hard protective covers.

ant.definition: A small insect with six legs that lives in organised groups.
ant.exampleUsage: The ant was identified during the lesson.

mosquito.definition: Two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals.
mosquito.exampleUsage: The mosquito was identified during the lesson.

dragonfly.definition: A flying insect with a long body and two pairs of wings.
dragonfly.exampleUsage: The dragonfly was identified during the lesson.

caterpillar.definition: A young insect that looks like a worm before becoming a butterfly or moth.
caterpillar.exampleUsage: The caterpillar was identified during the lesson.

spider.definition: A small animal with eight legs that makes webs.
spider.exampleUsage: The spider was identified during the lesson.

scorpion.definition: (astrology) a person who is born while the sun is in Scorpio.

centipede.definition: Chiefly nocturnal predacious arthropod having a flattened body of 15 to 173 segments each with a pair of legs, the foremost pair being modified as prehensors.

termite.definition: Whitish soft-bodied ant-like social insect that feeds on wood.
termite.exampleUsage: The termite was identified during the lesson.

grasshopper.definition: A jumping insect with long back legs that eats plants.
grasshopper.exampleUsage: The grasshopper was identified during the lesson.

firefly.definition: Tropical American click beetle having bright luminous spots.

palm-tree.definition: A tall tree with long leaves growing in warm climates.

vine.definition: A climbing or trailing plant with a long thin stem.

fern.definition: A plant with soft green leaves and no flowers.

bamboo.definition: The hard woody stems of bamboo plants.

orchid.definition: A tropical flower with unusual shapes and bright colours.

liana.definition: A woody climbing usually tropical plant.

canopy.definition: A rooflike covering that provides shade or shelter.

root.definition: The part of a plant that grows underground and takes in water.

trunk.definition: The main woody stem of a tree.

leaf.definition: A flat green part of a plant that uses light to make food.

flower.definition: The colourful part of a plant that often grows from a stem.

waterfall.definition: Water falling from a high place to a lower one.

river.definition: A natural flow of water moving through the land.

stream.definition: A narrow flow of water moving through the ground.

swamp.definition: A situation fraught with difficulties and imponderables.

mud.definition: To soil with mud, muck, or mire.

rock.definition: A hard natural material found on the ground.

cave.definition: To hollow out as if making a cave or opening.

cliff.definition: A steep wall of rock or earth.

ravine.definition: A deep narrow steep-sided valley (especially one formed by running water).

lagoon.definition: A body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral.

understory.definition: Vegetation growing above the forest floor and beneath the canopy forms a shaded layer of small trees, shrubs, and young saplings.

forest-floor.definition: The ground beneath trees in a forest.

clearing.definition: A tract of land with few or no trees in the middle of a wooded area.

trail.definition: A path through a natural area for walking.

bridge.definition: A structure built over water or a low place for people to cross.

tree-house.definition: A small structure for playing that is built among a tree’s branches.

rope.definition: A strong cord used for tying or securing things.

hammock.definition: A hanging bed made from fabric or netting.

campsite.definition: A site where people on holiday can pitch a tent.

screech.definition: A high-pitched noise resembling a human cry.

buzz.definition: To make a low humming sound, like a flying insect.

chirp.definition: A sharp sound made by small birds or insects.
chirp.exampleUsage: The chirp was identified during the lesson.

rustle.definition: To make a soft dry sound as leaves or fabric move.

splash.definition: A small quantity of something moist or liquid.

humidity.definition: The amount of water vapour in the air.

banana-plant.arabicTranslation: كائن أو عنصر طبيعي يُسمّى «بانانا بلانت»
banana-plant.definition: A large tropical plant that produces bunches of bananas.

rubber-tree.arabicTranslation: كائن أو عنصر طبيعي يُسمّى «روببير تريي»
rubber-tree.definition: A tropical tree that produces latex used to make natural rubber.

rope-bridge.definition: A bridge built from ropes instead of rigid beams carries people across a gap or stretch of water.

rainfall.definition: Water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere.
